caption: The drawing depicts a single, wooden-handled object resembling a stamp or seal, oriented horizontally on a plain, off-white background. The handle is bulbous and tapers smoothly into a slightly conical, textured section, painted in various shades of brown and beige to suggest wood grain and subtle shadows. Attached to the left end of the object is a rectangular base with a crosshatched surface, likely representing the stamping or impression surface. The base rests perpendicular to the handle, and small cracks and lines on the object indicate wear. Directly to the right of the object, the name “John Hill” is written in small, neat capital letters. The composition is centered horizontally and features no additional objects or details in the background.
title: Butter Mold
